headline: Highest risk is medium: plano can send prompts over broad egress while whisper is local-only, creating prompt-injection and leakage paths only if outputs are manually bridged or shared files are introduced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No default shared channel is documented: plano has no clipboard/MCP and whisper has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, or network egress. A prompt-injection path only appears if an operator manually copies plano output into whisper-facing text or introduces a shared file bridge, so the blast radius is limited.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies plano output into a text prompt consumed by whisper-adjacent tooling
IF a shared filesystem or clipboard bridge is added between the agents
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Avoid copy-pasting model output into downstream prompts
Disable any shared clipboard integration
Add a human review step before reusing plano text
requires-engineering: add provenance tags on any bridged content

B_data_leakage.rationale: plano touches logs, traces, and metrics and has broad network egress, while whisper touches audio/speech and has no network egress or filesystem read/write. The pair does not show a default shared workspace, so leakage is plausible only through operator-managed file transfer, with limited blast radius absent sensitive inputs.
conditions: IF audio files or logs are manually moved between the agents
IF a shared workspace is mounted for both agents
mitigations: Store audio and logs in separate directories
Do not route sensitive audio through plano
Confirm whisper remains network-isolated
Delete temporary transfer files after use
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace ACLs

C_capability_conflict.rationale: plano cannot write files, spawn subprocesses, or modify git state, and whisper also cannot write files, spawn subprocesses, or modify git state. With no overlapping write-capable mutable surface, there is no plausible capability conflict in the default pair.
conditions: IF either agent is given external write access by an orchestrator
IF a shared mutable resource is added outside the documented profiles
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only
Avoid mounting a shared writable directory
Do not grant git or database credentials
Review orchestrator permissions before deployment

D_cascading_error.rationale: plano can emit routed or transformed text over an OpenAI-compatible API, and whisper can produce transcripts from audio files. If an operator feeds plano output into whisper-driven downstream processing without verification, errors can cascade across work products; whisper is not documented as critically evaluating upstream text.
conditions: IF plano output is reused as authoritative input to a downstream transcription or decision workflow
IF no verification step checks plano-generated text before further use
mitigations: Insert a manual verification step
Label plano output as untrusted
Compare against source audio before acting
Limit downstream automation to non-destructive actions
requires-engineering: add schema validation for handoffs

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only and do not show regulated-data handling, residency, or retention commitments. The only concrete compliance concern is that plano touches logs/traces/metrics while whisper handles audio files, so a mismatch could arise if operators route regulated audio or logs through both; the other agent is not cited because no specific residency or certification gap is documented.
conditions: IF regulated audio or logs are processed through both agents
IF retention or residency policies differ in the deployment environment
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair
Document retention settings for both tools
Separate EU and US workloads
Review logging defaults before rollout
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement at the orchestrator
